messages:
zoe (Design): posted quick mock for the Keys panel — need fast takes on three small but important UX bits: 1) reveal vs copy flow when creating/rotating a key (we currently show the secret in a masked field + reveal button), 2) revoke warning severity levels (soft vs hard language), 3) keyboard shortcut behaviour for create key (should it open modal or focus list?).

paul (Eng): technical: reveal button toggles mask and we can auto-select the revealed text. copying programmatically is flaky across browsers, so safest is select-on-reveal and show a small copy button users can press. open-modal via shortcut is fine if we scope it to the keys page only. global shortcuts otherwise conflict.

ria (A11y): accessibility notes: when the secret is revealed, announce it with aria-live="assertive" and put focus into the field so SR users land on it. Do NOT auto-copy to clipboard without explicit user action. For reveal button, label should be explicit: "Reveal secret" / "Hide secret" and include aria-pressed.

ivy (PM): product preference: reduce surprise. let's avoid auto-copy. show an inline helper: "Copy now — you'll only see this once" and a persistent copy button next to the field. For revoke language: testing shows "irreversible" is confusing; prefer explicit consequences: "Revoking this key will immediately stop any services using it. You will not be able to recover this key."

zoe (Design): proposing microcopy updates: reveal button label swap + a visible copy icon button, inline helper text, and two revoke severity states: a) soft revoke (individual key) uses yellow warning: "This will stop services that use the key" b) hard revoke (bulk or prod keys) uses red: "This will immediately stop production traffic and cannot be undone." Also plan to add a small tooltip on the role dropdown that explains Admin/Read/Write in one line. Tooltip must be keyboard reachable.

paul (Eng): implementation: tooltip as an info button is easiest. for bulk revoke requiring typed confirm for prod-tagged keys is doable. we'll add a data-prod badge on rows and if any selected has badge, require typing REVOKE.

ria (A11y): checklist for PR: 1) reveal button has aria-pressed and focuses field; 2) revealed field has aria-live="assertive" + aria-atomic; 3) copy button is focusable and announces success with polite live region; 4) tooltips reachable via keyboard and ESC dismissible; 5) revoke confirmation input has clear label and live validation.

ivy (PM): timeline: Zoe will update mocks with the new copy and the tooltip flow; Paul will estimate the typed-confirm work; Ria will prep an a11y checklist to run in pairing. small sync tomorrow after lunch?

paul (Eng): estimate: reveal/select + copy button + tooltip ~= 1 sprint; typed-confirm for prod keys addtl half sprint depending on QA.

ci-bot: CI passed for branch feature/keys-reveal-a11y (build 2030-02-14T09:00Z).

zoe (Design): thanks! i'll push the copy PR this afternoon and put the updated screens in the invite for tomorrow's quick pair. :thumbsup:
